items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I told her, I said, Chick, I used to call her Chick... Let's play another selection... I told Chick, I said Chick, I got him.

ctx.x: No. Yeah. It was peculiar the way I got in there. You see, the lady that I'm telling you all about, Miss Todd, she sang. You see? And those people would be sitting down eating, you understand? And I told her, I said, Chick, I used to call her Chick, you know, I said, Chick, you know what do we do? Let's play another selection. Nice selection. You see? And I'll take that horn, you understand? And I could play that horn. You could be sitting down there, you could always hear it.
Just somehow. Did you use your mute or just soften it?
